q: Solomonoff's universal prior m(x) = Σ_{U(p)=x} 2^{-|p|} (sum over programs p whose output starts with x) is important because:
opts: It is a computable probability distribution
It dominates every computable prior up to a multiplicative constant
It equals the Shannon measure on strings
It is the unique maximum entropy distribution
exp: Solomonoff's prior m is a semi-measure that dominates all computable semi-measures: for every computable semi-measure μ, m(x) ≥ c_μ · μ(x). This makes it the ideal Bayesian prior for induction.
